entities.name: Peace Summit at Korlinda
entities.description: Planned meeting between Kroog and the Fallaji Empire at Korlinda that ended in violence.

entities.name: Korlinda
entities.description: Military camp in Korlis where the summit was held.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Kingdom of the Warlord whose forces attended the summit.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Independent, neutral kingdom hosting the summit.

entities.name: Warlord of Kroog
entities.description: Ruler of Kroog assassinated by the Qadir.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: Ruler of the Fallaji Empire who killed the Warlord.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Chief Artificer of Yotia; brother of Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Raki to the Qadir; brother of Urza.

entities.name: Rusko
entities.description: Planned the show of force with the Warlord.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Used the Staff of Zegon to weaken the avenger.

entities.name: Urza's avenger
entities.description: Machine that choked the Qadir and exploded from overload.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Stone Urza used to strengthen his avenger.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Stone Mishra used, overloading the avenger.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Mentor whose camp the brothers had left.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra attend the summit and meet for the first time since leaving Tocasia's camp.
events.quote: The brothers saw each other for the first time at the summit since they had left Tocasia's camp.

events.summary: The Warlord and Qadir fail to agree on the Sword Marches and a fight breaks out; the Warlord orders the ornithopters to bomb the dragon engine.
events.quote: The Warlord ordered the ornithopters to bomb the dragon engine

events.summary: The Qadir stabs the Warlord to death in retaliation.
events.quote: the Qadir assassinated the Warlord in a quick fit of rage

events.summary: Urza's avenger chokes the Qadir until Ashnod weakens it; Urza's Mightstone and Mishra's Weakstone overload it and it explodes.
events.quote: The opposite forces overloaded the Avenger, making it explode.

events.summary: The Fallaji flee across the Kher Ridges, harassed by ornithopters and ground troops.
events.quote: The Fallaji fled across the Kher Ridges
